title: Consciousness
tagline: Chitta — exploring the depths of awareness
description: Dive deep into the mechanics of consciousness, understanding how thoughts arise and how to find the stillness that lies beneath them.

sutra.meaning:
Yoga is the stilling of the fluctuations of the Consciousness ie Chitta. The Chitta comprises of the Manas, Buddhi, Ahamkar. The mind, intellect and ego.
Then the seer abides in their true nature.

sections.insight:
The mind keeps moving. Awareness—not suppression—brings stillness. Yoga shows us how. 
When the mind settles you experience your true self—peaceful and aware.
sections.reflectionPrompt: When is my mind most restless?
sections.meditation:
3 min breathing. 
Pause and observe moments of stillness . meditate for 10 min
sections.journalPrompt: Did I observe repetitive thoughts? I should watch like I hawk which thoughts are frequent visitors.

sections.gurudevInsight: There are certain vritis of the mind, which are problematic, which cause difficulties & certain others which do not cause any difficulty. Tada drushte swarupe awasthanam - It puts you on to your self, otherwise what has been happening? Vrutti sarupya mitaratra- Your mind is engaged - is caught up in outside world all the time. Eyes open, you are caught up in all that you see.

sutra.meaning:
There are 5 types of mental modulations
They are- 1.seeking validity of knowledge, 2.perverse or wrong knowledge, 3.imagination or delusion, 4.sleep and 5.memory.

sections.insight:
Some thoughts disturb some don’t. Awareness helps you choose.

sections.gurudevInsight:
"Pramanaviparyayavikalpanidrasmruti You call it mind or consciousness or chitta – it’s all the same – different modes of consciousness. Five modes of Consciousness arises in your Self. ""Pramana - 1st Activity of the mind. Your mind is engaged in wanting a proof. Are you in
Switzerland? Right Now? You say yes, how? You have a proof in the mind?
Three types of pramana –Pratyaksha – anumana, agama. Pratyaksha means obvious – experiencial. Anumana, it’s not so obvious, but you guess, & whatever you guess,
you believe in it.Agama pramana is the scriptures because it is written in black & white, believing in it is easy.
II. Viparyaya :- Patanjali very beautifully described each of these modulations.
“Viparyayo mithyagyanamatadupratistham”. Pramana is the knowledge that the mind is
constantly engaged in arguments, in proofs. This moment there could be arguing, proving there could be some logic in your mind, looking for a proof or it will have a wrong understanding. You will think things the way they are not. Most of the time you impose your own views & ideas & feelings on others and you think that is how they are. This activity of mind is called viparyaya.
(III) Vikalpa :- It is sort of hallucination. Nothing of that sort exists. Just mere words hover in the mind. All these fears, all these unfounded baseless mere sounds which do not carry much meaning, such thoughts, such ideas are called Vikalpa – fantasies..Fourth is (IV) Nidra :- When the mind is not in any of the above three, the fourth place,it goes to sleep. (V) Smruti (Memory) 5th activity of the mind. That is remembering the experiences it had had. Remembering the past experiences i.e smruti. Now see, when you are awake, are you in any of these four states of Modulations?

sutra.meaning: The active fluctuations (vrittis) or manifestations of the mental afflictions (kleshas)—which have been reduced to a subtle state—are to be overcome or eliminated through meditation (dhyana).

sections.insight: Afflictions are of three intensities: gross (sthula), subtle (suksma), and subtlest of the subtle (suksmatama). Tapas, swadhyaya and Ishwara pranidhana erase all of these afflictions.

sections.gurudevInsight: But once that craving gets eliminated then they are able to take a deep silence, sit & go deep inside. As soon as that get loosened, the feverishness, the kleshas, the miseries gets reduced, it allows the mind to get back to the source. Now what is the way to get rid of these miseries in life? “Dhyaandhyeya stabdh vruttiya” These five miseries can be eliminated through Meditation. Miseries can be overcome through Meditation & it must be done, he emphasizes. 70 You have to get rid of them only through Meditation.
